659:t_191:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「This is bad...! This is very bad!」

659:t_191:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「This man... he carries the sun within his body!」

659:t_191:3.en:
$$万丈$$
「I'll be your opponent! Ravenous destroyers! If you're not afraid of the brilliance of this radiant sun, then come at me!」

659:t_192:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You bastard! If you swallow us, it'll be a lot worse than a stomachache!」

659:t_192:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「There's no need to worry, boy.」

659:t_192:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「By becoming one with us, you too will gain eternity.」

659:t_192:3.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「No way I'm turning into such a creepy shape! Not a chance!」

659:t_192:4.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Get ready, you pests of space! $$トライダー$$, $c and I will exterminate you right here!」

659:t_193:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「If you have heads to think with and still attack people, you're no different from criminals!」

659:t_193:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You would impose Earthling rules... Earthling logic... on us here?」

659:t_193:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Small...! Far too small, boy!」

659:t_193:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Justice strikes down evil! That rule applies on Earth and in space alike!」

659:t_193:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「No need to hold back, $$鉄人$$! Take them on to your heart's content!」

659:t_194:0.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「So you've come, wielder of the power of light!」

659:t_194:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Your soul and your body of steel, all of it will be ours! With the power of this Great Void!」

659:t_194:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「What power of the Great Void!? We're alive... we exist!」

659:t_194:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「Let's go, $$マジンガー$$! With our power, we'll tear through their infinite darkness!」

659:t_195:0.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Come, warrior of the $$ゲッター線$$!」

659:t_195:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「We'll settle right here which of us is the one chosen by the $$ゲッター線$$!」

659:t_195:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Just what I wanted, $$インベーダー#pilot$$s!」

659:t_195:3.en:
$$隼人$$
「Come to think of it, we've been dealing with these guys for quite a long time now.」

659:t_195:4.en:
$$弁慶$$
「And while we're at it, the same goes for you guys.」

659:t_195:5.en:
$$隼人$$
「Too bad. Even if we beat these guys, it looks like the $$ゲッター$$ Team still won't be breaking up.」

659:t_195:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Our fight isn't over yet! We can't keep wasting our time on punks like these!」

659:t_195:7.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Let's go, $$ゲッター$$! We'll blow their Great Void away!」

659:t_196:0.en:
$$號$$
(The Great Void... eternal darkness... The greatest and strongest enemy of living beings...)

659:t_196:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Emissary of the $$ゲッター線$$! Are you helpless before our mighty power!?」

659:t_196:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Now that you know your place, quietly let yourself be absorbed by us!」

659:t_196:3.en:
$$凱$$
「Quit spacing out, $$號$$! The giant $$インベーダー#pilot$$ is right in front of you!」

659:t_196:4.en:
$$渓$$
「I'm counting on you, $$號$$. We're leaving our lives and the power of the $$ゲッター$$, all of it, in your hands!」

659:t_196:6.en:
$$號$$
「Let's do this, $$ゲッター$$! We'll overcome the Great Void to carve out the future!」

659:t_197:0.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You who hold both the factor of light and that of darkness! Your name is $$マーズ$$!」

659:t_197:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「One half of your being is of the same essence as our Great Void! In other words, you are one of us!」

659:t_197:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「This malice doesn't belong to them alone! The entire space is trying to devour everything that lives!」

659:t_197:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「I won't lose! ...As long as I have life, I'll keep fighting for the oath I made to my brother!」

659:t_198:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「The day has finally come, $$インベーダー#pilot$$s! Today I'm settling things with you once and for all!」

659:t_198:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Spiral Man! If you too mean to challenge the $$御使い$$s, offer that power to us!」

659:t_198:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Then a chance of defeating them will be born! That is our hope!」

659:t_198:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「No thanks! My friends and I will fight the $$御使い$$s without borrowing any of your power!」

659:t_198:4.en:
$$シモン$$
「Here I go! Your incomprehensible logic and your ambitions, my drill will punch through them all!」

659:t_199:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$バアル$$...! Humanity's natural enemy...!」

659:t_199:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Can you win? We possess a power beyond compare with those incarnations of endless destruction you fought!」

659:t_199:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「We are the emissaries of the Great Void... of the force that seeks to vanish! We are the ones who will remake this universe!」

659:t_199:3.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Since they named themselves $$バアル$$, you needn't hold back, $$ノリコ$$!」

659:t_199:5.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$ガンバスター$$'s mission is to protect humanity! We're the ones you'll be fighting!」

659:t_200:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You're not $$バアル$$, but you were $$バアル$$ after all!」

659:t_200:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「You're not $$バアル$$, but you were $$バアル$$ after all!」

659:t_200:2.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「You're not $$バアル$$, but you were $$バアル$$ after all!」

659:t_200:3.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「In that case, the name $$バアル$$ no longer matters!」

659:t_200:4.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「We will devour everything! You, the $$御使い$$s, even this universe!」

659:t_200:5.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I won't go easy on an enemy like that! Because...!」

659:t_200:6.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「I won't go easy on an enemy like that! Because...!」

659:t_200:7.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「I won't go easy on an enemy like that! Because...!」

659:t_200:8.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ is a $$バスターマシン$$! Because I'm the power to protect humanity from $$バアル$$!」

659:t_200:9.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「$$ノノ$$ is a $$バスターマシン$$! Because I'm the power to protect humanity from $$バアル$$!」

659:t_200:10.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「$$ノノ$$ is a $$バスターマシン$$! Because I'm the power to protect humanity from $$バアル$$!」

659:t_201:0.en:
$$葵$$
「Thinking this is the last I'll see of your gross faces really gets me fired up!」

659:t_201:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Ugly!? You call this form of ours ugly!?」

659:t_201:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Absurd! We are a species with the strongest power in the universe! Power must be beauty!」

659:t_201:3.en:
$$葵$$
「We really have nothing in common with you, starting with taste!」

659:t_201:4.en:
$$葵$$
「We're ending this here, $$インベーダー#pilot$$s! Let's do this!!」

659:t_202:0.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You don't know your place, salarymen! Wandering all the way out to the galaxy will be your undoing!」

659:t_202:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「But even that recklessness is strength! Become one with us!」

659:t_202:2.en:
$$赤木$$
「M&A? No deal! We're people who live with all we've got, crying and laughing!」

659:t_202:3.en:
$$赤木$$
「You who take lives on your own selfish logic, we stop you here! That's our duty... the duty of humans!!」

659:t_203:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「A pity. It's true I can communicate with you, but there's no talking to you.」

659:t_203:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「It can't be helped. Earthlings probably cannot understand our words.」

659:t_203:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「But don't worry. If you become one with us, there will be no problem at all.」

659:t_203:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I'm saying that selfish, forceful logic of yours isn't worth debating.」

659:t_203:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Therefore, I'll match your methods! It will be a rough approach, but think of it as your own doing!」

659:t_204:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
「We're alive...! Everyone wants to live!」

659:t_204:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
「If you're going to take that away...! Then I too, to protect everyone...!」

659:t_204:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Futile, boy. What can one human do?」

659:t_204:3.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「But the artificial human you ride is fascinating. We want that power, by all means!」

659:t_204:4.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I won't hand over the EVA...! It's all I have left!」

659:t_205:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What's this 'Great Void' crap!? We who are alive will blow that away!」

659:t_205:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You've got plenty of spirit, I'll give you that, boy.」

659:t_205:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「But I can feel it... A small but strong power that protects this boy!」
